edit.title: Edit user
edit.description: Change the name or email of this user.
edit.name: Name
edit.emailLockedSelf: Change your own email in your account settings.
edit.emailLockedAdmin: The email of an admin cannot be changed. Change their role first.

ban.title: Ban user
ban.description: The user is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until the ban ends.
ban.untilHint: Leave empty for a permanent ban.

unban.title: Unban user
unban.description: The user can sign in again.

role.title: Change system role
role.description: System admins can manage every user and organization.
role.demoteHint: Demoting an admin signs them out everywhere.

resetTwoFactor.title: Reset two-factor authentication
resetTwoFactor.description: Turns off two-factor authentication, deletes the authenticator secret and backup codes, and signs the user out. Use it for locked-out users.

impersonate.title: Impersonate user
impersonate.description: You will be signed in as {email} for a limited time. Everything you do is recorded.
impersonate.limits: Payments, credentials, two-factor, API keys and leaving or deleting organizations stay blocked while impersonating.

delete.title: Delete user
delete.description: Permanently deletes {email} and their data. This cannot be undone.

revokeAll.title: Revoke all sessions
revokeAll.description: The user is signed out everywhere, including connected MCP apps.
